title: Maximal Enhancements in Eight-Dimensional Non-Supersymmetric Heterotic Strings
summary: We classify maximally enhanced, rank-preserving non-supersymmetric heterotic strings in eight dimensions by studying orbifolds of supersymmetric heterotic strings on $T^2$. We first review the construction in nine dimensions, where it reproduces the $95$ maximally semisimple enhancement points obtained from previous extended-Dynkin analyses. We then start from the maximally enhanced supersymmetric Narain points in eight dimensions and use Kac's theorem to enumerate candidate order-two inner actions, retaining only those that lift to consistent Narain-lattice shifts.
